exclusions: Arbitrary dynamic dispatch, unexpanded macros and unresolved configuration cannot establish complete absence; their frozen expected uncertainty is retained.

Cross-effect negative controls depend on explicit accepted research primitive bounds for exact literal-borrow and fresh-command synthetic sources. Installed default summaries remain partial; unconfigured uncertainty and assumption references are retained. Child-process behavior, kernel hooks and allocator replacement are outside that direct primitive boundary.
Deterministic fixtures and two file scopes do not establish real-world precision, false-positive rates, statistical confidence, independent human validation or external assurance.
Earlier unreproduced historical populations remain unqualified.
Effect-policy conformance is bounded to the frozen primitive-language and public-file envelope; it does not qualify general control/data flow or all Rust effects.
Held-out cases are exposed after the first scored run; failed first observations remain retained and replays are disclosed.
Pinned public source bytes are governed by research-authored wrappers at original paths, not a complete original upstream build or repository certification.
